description: Source code for ACPI shell commands in Zephyr RTOS, providing functions to dump device resources, enumerate devices, retrieve device resources, and read ACPI tables via shell commands.

methods.name: dump_dev_res
methods.description: Prints detailed information about ACPI device resources, handling various resource types.

methods.name: dump_dev_crs
methods.description: Shell command to retrieve and dump current device resources via ACPI _CRS method.

methods.name: dump_dev_prs
methods.description: Shell command to retrieve and dump possible device resources via ACPI _PRS method.

methods.name: dump_prt
methods.description: Displays PCIe PRT (Power Resource Table) details for a given bus, device, and function.

methods.name: enum_dev
methods.description: Enumerates a specific device using its HID.

methods.name: enum_all_dev
methods.description: Enumerates all ACPI devices in the namespace.

methods.name: get_acpi_dev_resource
methods.description: Retrieves and displays MMIO and IRQ resources for a specified device.

methods.name: read_table
methods.description: Reads and displays information from an ACPI table.
